apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: actionq-pg
  namespace: vuoro-shared
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: actionq-pg
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  loadBalancerClass: io.cilium/l2-announcer
  loadBalancerIP: ${ACTIONQ_LB_IP}
  externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
  loadBalancerSourceRanges:
    - ${DEVBOX_VM_IP}/32
  selector:
    cnpg.io/cluster: vuoro-postgres
    cnpg.io/instanceRole: primary
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
      protocol: TCP
